alt.en: The curved, pale gray facade of the Berlaymont building in Brussels fills the frame under a light sky, with three blue European Union flags flying in front of it at lower right.
alt.zh: 布鲁塞尔 Berlaymont 大楼弧形的浅灰色立面占满画面，上方是淡色的天空，右下方大楼前飘着三面蓝色的欧盟旗帜。

caption.en: European Union flags outside the Berlaymont building in Brussels, the European Commission's headquarters, in October 2022. The photo does not show CEN-CENELEC, which drafted EN 18286.
caption.zh: 2022 年 10 月，欧盟委员会总部所在的布鲁塞尔 Berlaymont 大楼外的欧盟旗帜。照片中并非起草 EN 18286 的 CEN-CENELEC。
